mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate weakening demand and supply conditions, causing negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Either HOUST or INDPRO alone has a Rank IC > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows, indicating the interaction is unnecessary.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2% quarterly signals robust economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns during late-cycle expansion phases.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >60% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 2% during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Continuously rising payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window for 5-day returns.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 195.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 195.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS alone has Rank IC > 0.05 or HOUST alone has Rank IC > 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 during manufacturing slowdowns indicates supply chain disruptions that reduce corporate profitability and generate negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during INDPRO decline.
